title: Logic inversion in organization creation: The slug property is now conditionally set when IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED is tru
description: Logic inversion in organization creation: The slug property is now conditionally set when IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED is true, instead of when it's false as originally intended. This change, combined with requestedSlug still being set when IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED is true, results in both properties being set when billing is enabled, and neither when disabled
